data.name: Chitrabanu
data.gender_notes: Chitrabanu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Depicts the beautiful sight of the sky, symbolizing the vastness and beauty of the universe. The name Chitrabanu carries the meaning “Picture of the Sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chitrabanu usually hope their child will grow to embody picture of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine connection with the cosmic energy.
data.etymology: Chitrabanu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Picture of the Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chitrabanu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: चित्रबानु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chitra means picture or image and Bānu means the sun. Together, Chitrabanu means 'image of the sun' or 'sun image'.

in_hindi.name: चित्रबानु
in_hindi.long_meaning: चित्र बानु का अर्थ है चित्र या प्रतिभा और बानु सूर्य का अर्थ है। इसलिए चित्रबानु का अर्थ है सूर्य का चित्र या प्रतिभावान् सूर्य है।

in_tamil.name: சித்ரபானு
in_tamil.meaning: சித்திரம் அல்லது படம், அருகில் அளிக்கப்படும் அக்கினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: சித்திரம் அல்லது படம் அல்லது அருகில் அளிக்கப்படும் அக்கினி என்பது சித்ரபானு என்பது அர்தம் அளிக்கும்.

in_telugu.name: చిత్రబాను
in_telugu.long_meaning: చిత్రం లేదు అథవా సూర్యం ఎందుకంది అర్థం చిత్రబాను అందుకుందేమిటు.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Chitrabanu" is derived from Sanskrit words "Chitra" meaning picture or painting and "Banu" meaning son. It is a Bengali name rooted in Indian culture, most likely of Brahmin or Kshatriya origin. In Indian art, Chitrabanu is the name of the legendary artist originated from the Moon God's mind, who created pictures of the universe. The name evokes a sense of creativity and artistic prowess.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Hindu context, the name Chitrabanu carries significant spiritual symbolism. The name represents a deep connection with the cosmic consciousness and the Universe. The 'Banu' or 'son' part of the name can be interpreted as an embodiment of divine light. The individual named Chitrabanu is believed to possess the ability to manifest and perceive the intricacies of the universe, much like a divine artist. This name is often associated with intellectuals, artists, and spiritual seekers in pursuit of higher knowledge and self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chitrabanu: One who wears the canvas of life's diverse experiences and artfully paints it with the colors of wisdom and compassion.

vedic_reference.note: Not found in Vedas, Upanishads, or other scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Chitrabanu was a renowned Jain scholar and monk of the 12th century who is known for his commentary on the 'Agamamelaka Sutra'. He was a disciple of Haribhadra Suri and is considered one of the leading figures in the Jain scholarship during this period.

Another reference mentions Chitrabanu as a sage and poet, who composed hymns in praise of Lord Mahavira. These hymns were known as 'Stotras' and Chitrabanu is considered a great contributor to the Jain literature of this genre during the medieval period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Chitrabanu' is gaining popularity in modern contexts due to its unique combination of Hindu mythology and anime-inspired naming trends. This name is often seen on anime forums, where users create and discuss their own original characters. DeviantArt, a digital art community, features various pieces of artwork featuring 'Chitrabanu' as a character name, reflecting the trend of Hindu mythology revival in digital art. Lastly, on Reddit, users discuss and share their interpretations of 'Chitrabanu' in various Hindu mythology and anime-related subreddits, showcasing the versatility and adaptability of this name in contemporary culture.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Devi Chitrabanu in Delhi, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Chitrabanu, which means "Picture of the Sky". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
